attempts.summary: Repaired supervisor.py on node1. It now starts all requested jobs, waits for and reaps every child, records even jobs as 0 and odd jobs as 3, preserves existing results, and remains running until all children finish. The repair persisted across reboot without changing RHEL 10.0 or kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64.
